parent_objective: Full P6 coupled adaptive stability on compiled persistent HLA/HLB runtime, including M3 context/estimator, activation, dormancy/recovery, HLB relation integrity and resource envelope

p6_model.memory_input: SOE traces are DC-normalized channelwise by (1-exp(-gamma)) before aggregation
p6_model.dormancy: decay P6 state and SOE memory; freeze estimator, context and activation updates; gate native readout and control feedback to zero
p6_model.recovery: half-strength P6 input, native readout and control feedback until explicit recovery completion
p6_model.native_observation: mean native u at levels 1 and 2

context_bank.capacity_test: fill all four slots, present a fifth novel context, require abstention and no eviction

estimator.update_order: prequential prediction, observed native target, then sufficient-statistic update
estimator.checkpoint: full Gram upper triangle, cross-statistics, sample/prediction/update counters

activation.evidence: prequential predictive improvement with identifiability and accepted context gate

coupling.readout_gate: active relation plus accepted context; mode gain 0 in dormancy and 0.5 in recovery
coupling.control_gate: mode gain 0 in dormancy and 0.5 in recovery

candidate_lifecycle.promotion: independent validation; identifiable and validation improvement greater than 1e-8
rollback_sequence: checkpoint all native, three SOE, P6, context, estimator, activation, detector, revision and HLB store state
promote independently validated candidate and persist its context operator
insert a candidate-only HLB relation record during candidate continuation
exercise full composite rollback and require exact fingerprint equality
require candidate-only relation removal, protected witness preservation and exact incumbent replay

relation_store.candidate_only_record: insert as third record after promotion
relation_store.capacity_probe: fourth record must return ABSTAIN_CAPACITY without eviction
relation_store.rollback: restore exactly the two pre-candidate records and preserve protected witness

resource_envelope.accounting: M3 integrated numeric resource ledger plus P6 SOE memory; Python object/container overhead excluded

native_runtime.norm_limit_rationale: v3 core campaign observed 1212.7968; freeze 1500 as a 23.7 percent headroom finite-horizon operating ceiling for this v4 campaign, not a universal bound

independent_seed_policy: v4 seeds are disjoint from H1 train/validation/confirmatory seeds and P6 v1/v2/v3 seed sets
claim_boundary: finite-horizon coupled adaptive-state execution for the declared HLA/HLB native runtime, context/estimator, activation, dormancy/recovery, relation-store and resource configurations
not an ISS theorem or arbitrary-switching guarantee
not proof for other native kernels, timesteps, dimensions, capacities, input bounds or coupling gains
